structured.answer: Open a trading account at Psagot (פסגות) and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". At the page's default of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, you'd end up with about 86,900 ₪ in today's money after fees and tax. The page shows both 86,942 and 86,492 for the same choice, though.

stuck.where: Screen 1 vs screens 2 and 8, the final amount
stuck.why: The top card says 86,942 ₪ for the cheapest pair, while the account list and the waterfall chart say 86,492 ₪ for the same Psagot + Yelin Lapidot choice. I don't know which is right.
The task gave no amounts. I'd want 30,000 today, but I left the sliders as they were (10,000 + 500/month), so the result isn't for my real money.

stuck.where: Screen 2 coloured cost bar and legend
stuck.why: There are lots of colours (עמלות קנייה ומכירה, דמי משמרת, דמי ניהול חשבון, המרת מטבע, מס...) and I couldn't tell what the bars mean for me.
Long charts and tables about the dollar and נטרול. I got lost and bored; this is where I'd close the page.

findings.what: The same winning choice shows two different totals: 86,942 ₪ in the top card and 86,492 ₪ in the account list and the waterfall chart (swapped digits). It makes me doubt every number.
findings.where: Screen 1 main card vs screen 2 account list and screen 8 chart

findings.what: No obvious next step after picking the pair: nothing tells you how to actually open the Psagot account and buy the fund
Too many fund tags with words a beginner doesn't know (עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט"ח, מס דיבידנד בתוך הקרן, W-8BEN)
Coloured cost bars with a legend of 8 colours I can't follow
The long dollar-hedging section with two charts and a table is where I'd close the page; it should be folded away
The fund fee is shown only as a small percent (0%, 0.02%), not in shekels like the account cost
The range 'בין +2,212 ל-−23,766' is scary and confusing
English-only ETF rows with 'אין מחיר כאן' clutter the list
